proposals.name: Tarjetas claras
proposals.prompt:
Create one high-fidelity, professionally art-directed desktop WEBSITE PAGE design proposal for the Ciudad Cars "Vehículos" catalog, a local car rental company in Maracaibo, Venezuela. A complete flat front-facing web page mockup, no laptop frame, no perspective, no comparison board. Portrait canvas approximately 1440×1700 pixels with crisp, readable Spanish type and all FIVE vehicles visible. This is the dedicated catalog page, not the homepage carousel. Reference image 1 shows the cinematic Maracaibo setting and Mitsubishi Lancer; reference image 2 shows Ford Explorer and the matching scenery; reference image 3 is the official white/lime logo for navy backgrounds. Preserve this brand: navy #032640, corporate blue #0B3B82, bright lime #B6F331, white and cool light blue; NO black/gold luxury styling. Cars should look photographic and physically grounded with subtle natural shadows beneath their tires, no floating stickers, halos or decorative platforms. Use consistent Outfit-like UI typography and strong clear headings, careful spacing, restrained borders, meaningful iconography.
Shared navigation: official logo left; "Inicio", active "Vehículos", "Servicios", "Quiénes somos", "Contacto"; lime "Reservar ahora" CTA. Main heading exact: "Un carro para cada plan." Supporting line: "Elige el espacio y la comodidad que van contigo." A short breadcrumb "Inicio / Vehículos". Retain the catalog's actual functionality through clearly designed controls: category filter, passenger capacity filter, price sorting, result count "5 vehículos", per-vehicle "Reservar ahora" and "Ver detalles". Do not add dates, locations, payment checkout, star ratings, discounts, availability claims, wishlists, compare buttons or extra car models.
EXACT INVENTORY, in this order, each once:
1. "Económico" / "Mitsubishi Lancer" / "o similar" / "Desde $75/día" / "5 pasajeros" / "2 maletas".
2. "Premium" / "Chevrolet Cruze" / "o similar" / "Desde $85/día" / "5 pasajeros" / "2 maletas".
3. "Luxury" / "Toyota Camry" / "o similar" / "Desde $110/día" / "5 pasajeros" / "3 maletas".
4. "SUV" / "Jeep Cherokee" / "o similar" / "Desde $130/día" / "5 pasajeros" / "3 maletas".
5. "SUV Luxury" / "Ford Explorer" / "o similar" / "Desde $160/día" / "7 pasajeros" / "4 maletas".
All automatic, four doors, all prices USD per day. Compact shared note "Todos automáticos · Tarifas en USD / día". Make prices, models and CTA easy to scan. A minimal branded navy footer is sufficient; do not create new marketing sections. This is a polished design proposal to choose before implementation; do not print proposal letters or explanation annotations inside the website. DIRECTION A: AIRY WHITE CARD CATALOG. An elegant navy navigation bar, a compact split hero with large white/lime title on navy at left and a vivid Maracaibo sunset photo at right. Avoid a giant hero. Under this, a white and very pale cool-blue working area. One single clean horizontal filter toolbar: "Categoría: Todas", "Pasajeros: Todos", "Ordenar: Menor precio". Result count separated beneath. Beautiful, generous WHITE vehicle cards in THREE COLUMNS on the first row (Lancer, Cruze, Camry) and TWO CARDS on the second row (Cherokee, Explorer), retaining the same card widths. Each card has a photographic panoramic vehicle scene on top, a compact blue category label, large navy model, a neat icon/specification row, and a bottom section with price and a lime booking button. Details is a restrained blue text action. Very subtle cool-blue shadows, 12px corner radius, plenty of white space between cards. Strong hierarchy and uncluttered retail catalog clarity. Do not duplicate cars to fill the sixth grid space.
